title: Debunked! Mehdi Dismantles the Myth of Progressive ‘Underperformance’ in the Midterms
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Ever since the blue tsunami brought a wave of historic victories in the
midterms last week, centrist Democrats have been pushing a narrative that
progressives like Abdul El-Sayed and Troy Jackson underperformed in the
elections, while moderate candidates overperformed.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Now, in his latest monologue, **Mehdi** debunks this false narrative made up
of cherrypicked numbers and ridiculous comparisons that Democratic
establishment politicians and pundits are relying on to undermine the success
of left-wing candidates.

Watch the **full monologue above** , paywall-free, to see Mehdi give eight
reasons why the so-called moderates are wrong about progressive
"underperformance" in the midterms.
